label: set-fsm-mode off while off round 0 (warm-up)
why: T24 timing, window-only: with FSM already off, set-fsm-mode off reads GetIsFileDesignMode (disabled), probes GetApplicationInfo (off) and writes nothing, so no recycle follows. Both servers read the mode first. Run with --order alternate while the stand is in FSM off.

steps.why: clio's tool takes flat arguments (environmentName), so the read goes through clio-run on both sides, as in window/t12.json. It is an authenticated GetApplicationInfo call: it also brings each server's session and the stand's application up before the timed step.
steps.label: mode before
off
steps.why: Measured: the path with nothing to import and nothing to write.
